rules.qualifying_offer: gpu is a plain H100 80 GB (H100 NVL excluded); on demand (spot/interruptible excluded); price > 0 and gpu_count > 0; multi-node cluster SKUs excluded; available != false where the source has that field
rules.offer_value: price / gpu_count, rounded to the micro-dollar
rules.provider_value: median of the provider's qualifying offers that day (even count: mean of the two middle values, rounded down to the micro-dollar)
rules.source_priority: per provider and day, gpuhunt catalog first, then afhubbard parquet, then Akash Wayback capture
rules.composite: median of in-composite provider values, with at least 4 providers; otherwise no value (never interpolated)
rules.hyperscalers: aws, azure, gcp, oci are reported in hyperscalers.csv and kept out of the composite
rules.sampling: one file per source per day: the gpuhunt catalog found by probing run numbers for that date, the earliest afhubbard snapshot of the day, the earliest Akash capture of the day
